name: islamic-matchmaking-platform
description: Islamic Marriage & Matchmaking Platform - Sharia-compliant matrimonial platform

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend

scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
